checks.what: every stride the deposit shares is kept, in its order
step_length_asymmetry = (step_length_fast - step_length_slow) / sum on >= 98% of strides (labTools definitions; the rest are kept as shared)
step_position_asymmetry (Sout) = (leading_position_fast - leading_position_slow) / sum on >= 98% of strides (labTools definitions; the rest are kept as shared)
step_time_asymmetry (Tout) = (step_time_fast - step_time_slow) / stride_time on >= 98% of strides (labTools definitions; the rest are kept as shared)
the three contributions add up to step_length_asymmetry on >= 98% of strides (labTools definitions; the rest are kept as shared)
stride_time = step_time_fast + step_time_slow on >= 98% of strides (labTools definitions; the rest are kept as shared)
excluded_by_authors = labTools 'bad' flag (missing or disordered events, stride time out of range)
